scope: Automatically remove expired managed live-feedback session directories at the next session start after a 30-day UTC retention window; repair the latest-session pointer when its directory expires; preserve core application history and unrelated directories.

acceptance.expired_session_removed: PASS - synthetic session older than 30 days and its diagnostic file are removed from an isolated temporary output root.
acceptance.retention_boundary_preserved: PASS - directory timestamp exactly at the 30-day cutoff remains available.
acceptance.unrecognized_directory_preserved: PASS - malformed session-like name remains untouched.
acceptance.latest_pointer_repaired: PASS - pointer targeting a pruned session advances to the newest retained recognized session.
acceptance.automatic_startup_cleanup: PASS - new_session_directory invokes pruning before allocating a new session; test uses only a temporary root.
acceptance.application_history_preserved: PASS - synthetic application history outside the live-feedback root is unchanged.

test_first_red.observation: Before implementation, import failed because prune_expired_sessions did not exist. The same test passed after implementation.

commands.command: python -m tools.verification.agent_skills; python -m tools.verification.catalogue; python -m tools.verification.progress validate; python -m tools.coordination.lane_coordination validate; git diff --check

environment.browser: local headless Chromium synthetic redaction regression included; no external navigation
environment.filesystem: temporary directories only for all expiration/delete assertions

limitations: Issue #171 / MJ-REQ-170 remains OPEN/PARTIAL; this slice covers only cli.live_feedback session folders, not every transient artifact, log, raw payload or generated file in MJobs.
Pruning runs when a new live-feedback session starts; it is not a background scheduler.
No real user feedback/output directory or application history was inspected or deleted.
No full repository suite, PostgreSQL, Docker, hosted CI/review or external application flow was run.
